messages:
sam-sales: Heads-up — TelosBank reported a regression after last week’s rollout. P95 doubled and some requests 504.

sam-sales: Repro steps from customer: burst to 800 qps hitting /v1/generate with model=x-small-16k in eu-west-1

sam-sales: logs they pasted:
```
2026-03-14T18:21:12Z ERROR request handler timeout id=abcd1234 route=/v1/generate latency_ms=1203 queue_ms=890
2026-03-14T18:21:13Z WARN batching: batch size grew to 48 for route /v1/generate
```

jasper-product: @miriam-eng can we get an initial triage? sounds like queueing/backpressure.

miriam-eng: copying in @keisha-ops. Asking for which model variant + dedicated vs hosted for this customer.

sam-sales: TelosBank on Dedicated (reserved) in eu-west-1, pinned to model x-small-16k v3. They only started seeing issues after 2026-03-12 deploy.

keisha-ops: ops-bot created incident INC-2026-45 · linking to perf dashboard — noticing p95 jump aligned with deploy. Some workers hit GC spikes.

miriam-eng: actionable items: 1) repro load test with pinned model + 800 qps 2) capture runtimes + kernel traces 3) check batching policy change in deploy. Anyone own backlog ticket?

jasper-product: Product asks: add to backlog but need launch criteria: reproduce + mitigation (config rollback or autoscale tweak) OR customer-facing workaround. Prioritize P1 for TelosBank.

product-ops: agreed. I’ll open a backlog ticket and scope an M1: reproduce+hotfix, M2: policy change + QA. @jasper-product I’ll ping sales to set expectation window.

miriam-eng: quick note — temp mitigation: reduce max_batch_size to 8 for that route or enable aggressive kv-cache expiry. I’ll try config flip in staging now.

keisha-ops: staging flip done, running synthetic at 850 qps. If stable, we can schedule canary in dedicated pool later today.

sam-sales: thanks all. customer pinged: they want hourly updates. I'll keep them in the loop.
